<div class="page-heading"><div class="eyebrow">Academic trajectory</div><h1>Experience &amp; education</h1><p class="lede">Degrees, appointments and research visits — an academic timeline.</p></div><div class="experience-layout"><div class="experience-primary"><section class="section" id=""><h2>Appointments &amp; visits</h2><div class="timeline"><p><strong>2019–2023</strong> — Teaching appointment / PCC · École polytechnique, CMAP</p><p><strong>Sept.–oct. 2015</strong> — Visiting researcher · Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta</p><p><strong>2009–present</strong> — Associate Professor of Applied Mathematics · Université Paris Dauphine–PSL, CEREMADE (CNRS UMR 7534)</p><p><strong>2008–2009</strong> — ATER · Université Paris Diderot, LPMA</p></div></section><section class="section" id=""><h2>Education</h2><div class="timeline"><p><strong>2008</strong> — PhD in Statistics · Université Paris Diderot</p><p><strong>2005</strong> — Research Master’s in stochastic modelling and statistics · Université Paris Diderot</p><p><strong>2004</strong> — Maîtrise in Applied Mathematics · Université Pierre-et-Marie-Curie</p></div></section><section class="section" id=""><h2>Biography</h2><p>My research began in nonparametric statistics, inverse problems and quantum tomography. It subsequently expanded to neural-network generalization, contrastive methods, clustering and robust distributed learning. My academic work connects foundational research, doctoral supervision, teaching and collaborations with institutional and industry partners.</p><img alt="Kabylie" class="kabylie" src="kabylie.jpg" style="max-width:600px"/><div class="caption">Kabylie · personal photograph</div><p>My current research includes causal and counterfactual inference and a developing direction in adversarial machine learning, with attacks, defenses, data ownership verification and efficiency as research questions.</p></section></div><aside class="contact-card" aria-label="Contact"><div class="eyebrow">CEREMADE · DAUPHINE–PSL</div><h2>Contact</h2><div class="contact-label">Email</div><p class="contact-email">meziani[arobase]ceremade[dot]dauphine[dot]fr</p><div class="contact-label">Office address</div><address>Laboratoire CEREMADE<br>Université Paris Dauphine–PSL<br>Place du Maréchal de Lattre de Tassigny<br>75016 Paris<br>France</address></aside></div>
